{{Youmay|the agricultural method|[[Hydroponics (Death Star)|Hydroponics]], the area on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]]}}
{{Quote|You have hydroponics. Provides nice fresh vegetables.|[[Ben Skywalker]] to [[Koro Ziil|The Hidden One]]|<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Outcast">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]''</ref>}}
'''Hydroponics''' was the method of growing [[Plant/Legends|plants]] using mineral nutrient solutions in [[Water/Legends|water]] without the use of soil. The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Jamiron/Legends|Jamiron]] contained [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] hydroponic facilities. There was also an area called "[[Hydroponics (Death Star)|Hydroponics]]" on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] on level [[3-A]] that contained hydroponic technology. Hydroponic gardens were located in the caves underneath of [[Stav Kesh]] Temple on planet [[Tython/Legends|Tython]].<ref name="DOTJ:ITV">''[[Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void]]''</ref> The process for using specially selected hydroponic plants to produce [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]] and extract noxious gases and impurities was known as '''hydroponics recycling'''.<ref name="GSWU">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe]]''</ref>
